description: Quarantined legacy Stage 1 text-to-occupancy and pilot checkpoints (non-core production)

checkpoints.name: occupancy-dit-600.pt
checkpoints.description: Predicts coarse 16^3 active spatial occupancy from random Gaussian noise conditioned on CLIP text embeddings
checkpoints.notes: Trained for 600 steps on dual Tesla T4 GPUs. Euler sampling produces steerable spatial bounds.

checkpoints.name: occupancy-dit-64-4000.pt
checkpoints.stage: Stage 1 (Latent Occupancy DiT Flow - 64³ - Step 4000 - Scaled 2.8M)
checkpoints.description: Scaled 2.8M parameter Stage 1 Occupancy DiT predicting 4³ active latent occupancy with mini-batching (batch size 4), CosineAnnealingLR, and explicit volume loss
checkpoints.notes: Trained for 4,000 steps with width=144, heads=6, depth=6 (2.8M params), mini-batch size 4, and volume loss on 649 Kenney train assets at 64³ on Tesla T4 GPU. Mean validation occupancy IoU jumped to 0.5515 (+25.8% relative improvement), precision reached 0.8186, recall improved to 0.5973, and prompt steerability difference increased to 23.1 cells.
